visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women sit on a green velvet train seat; the woman on the left in a grey turtleneck and black lace dress waves and makes a peace sign, while the woman on the right in a black vest and white mask waves at the camera. (2) In a home hallway, a woman in a floral shirt leans over to push a toddler sitting on a red toy truck; the toddler grips the wooden handle while moving forward. (3) A close-up shot displays a square wooden box filled with rice, topped with glazed grilled eel on one side and thin slices of raw marbled beef on the other, accompanied by side dishes on a red tray. (4) Outdoors at a shrine, a woman leans over a wooden bin filled with small red fish charms, using a tiny fishing rod to hook one while other visitors stand in the blurred background. (5) In a kitchen, a person wearing a black-and-white striped shirt stirs ingredients in a frying pan on a gas stove; a large silver bag of soy protein is visible on the counter nearby. (6) Close-up shots show four square pieces of glossy braised tofu in a dark bowl, followed by a hand holding a yellow and red bag of frozen fish balls. (7) A screen recording shows a messaging app interface with Japanese and Chinese text bubbles, followed by a hand holding a green plastic jar of seasoning with a yellow label. (8) In a dimly lit bedroom, a toddler sleeps peacefully under a patterned blanket; a hand enters the frame to gently pat the child's chest. (9) A fast-paced montage features five different plates of food: stir-fried tofu with pork, onions with meat, stir-fried cabbage, scrambled eggs with shrimp, and a pot of soup with white fish balls and radish. (10) A young man sits at a dining table with his hands clasped in prayer before eating, then he and the young woman from the first scene are shown eating rice from bowls and smiling with satisfaction.
